# Data Model

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Storage

- Engine: MySQL 8 for dev/prod (`docker-compose.yml` service `mysql:8.0` with volume `sail-mysql`; `.env.example` `DB_CONNECTION=mysql`, `DB_DATABASE=maxdraw`). `config/database.php` falls back to `env('DB_CONNECTION', 'sqlite')`.
- Tests run on SQLite `:memory:` (`phpunit.xml` `DB_CONNECTION=sqlite`, `DB_DATABASE=:memory:`), with `RefreshDatabase` applied to the whole `Feature` suite via `tests/Pest.php`.
- Schema location: `database/migrations/` — 21 files. 5 framework/auth (`users`, `cache`, `jobs`, `passkeys`, two-factor columns); 13 domain-table creations timestamped `2026_08_22_2100xx`, in FK dependency order; and 2 dated `2026_08_23_0853xx` that add `training_sessions.show_connection_order` (backfilling `edges[].order = null`) and then drop the numbering-mode lookup that the explicit connection order replaced — 12 domain tables survive; plus 1 dated `2026_08_25_025639` that adds the nullable `training_sessions.name`, additive and with no backfill (a pre-existing session simply stays nameless).
- Migration tool: Laravel migrations (`php artisan migrate`; CI runs `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force`). No second migration framework.
- Seed data: `database/seeders/CatalogSeeder` + 10 child seeders, idempotent `upsert`. `database/seeders/data/problems.php` holds the 14 statements as a PHP array.
- `AppServiceProvider::configureDefaults()` calls `DB::prohibitDestructiveCommands(app()->isProduction())` and `Date::use(CarbonImmutable::class)`.
- 13 domain tables, enumerated in `tests/Pest.php::domainTables()` and swept by `tests/Feature/Migrations/`.

### Entities

#### `training_sessions` — the only table the app writes at runtime

`database/migrations/2026_08_22_210054_create_training_sessions_table.php`, `app/Models/TrainingSession.php`.

| Column | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | bigint PK | |
| `user_id` | FK → `users.id` | `cascadeOnDelete` — deleting an account deletes its sessions |
| `problem_id` | FK → `problems.id`, nullable | `restrictOnDelete` |
| `name` | string, nullable | The label the candidate writes for the drill — free text, no lookup and no Enum, so no uniqueness either. The 60-char ceiling lives in `TrainingSessionUpdateRequest` (`MAX_SESSION_NAME`), not in the column width; `null` means "unnamed", and the session sheet then falls back to the problem name |
| `session_duration_id` | FK → `session_durations.id` | `restrictOnDelete` |
| `show_connection_order` | boolean, default `true` | cast `boolean` — without the cast SQLite would hand the resource `1`/`0`; display flag only, never diagram content |
| `elapsed_seconds` | integer, default 0 | cast `integer` |
| `notes` | text, nullable | max 5000 chars enforced in the FormRequest |
| `nodes` | json | cast `array`; `[{id,type,label,x,y}]`, max 200 entries |
| `edges` | json | cast `array`; `[{id,from,to,kind,label,dashed,bidir,order}]`, max 400 entries; `order` is `int\|null` and carries the sequence — the array position means nothing |
| `checks` | json | cast `array`; map `checklist_items.id` → bool |
| `estimate` | json | cast `array`; `{mode,dau,act,per_month,ratio,size,peak,ret}` |
| `last_opened_at` | timestamp, not null | cast `datetime`; `MAX()` per user defines the current session |
| `created_at` / `updated_at` | timestamps | `updated_at` is the autosave version token returned to the client |

Indexes: `(user_id, last_opened_at)` for the current-session lookup and the session sheet ordering; `(user_id, created_at)`.

Relationships: `belongsTo` `User`, `Problem` (nullable), `SessionDuration`; inverse `User::trainingSessions()` `hasMany`.

Derived attribute: `duration_minutes` — `Attribute::get(fn () => $this->sessionDuration->minutes)`; the DB stores the FK, the API speaks minutes.

Scope: `#[Scope] ownedBy(Builder, User)` — the first lock of per-user isolation; used by the route binding, `CurrentSessionResolver` and `index`.

Invariants:
- `user_id` never arrives from the client (absent from `TrainingSessionUpdateRequest::rules()`) and is never emitted (`TrainingSessionResource`).
- `nodes`/`edges`/`checks`/`estimate` are written together inside one `DB::transaction` (`SessionStateWriter`), so no session holds half a drawing.
- `edges[].from`/`to` must reference ids present in the same `nodes` payload and must differ from each other.
- `checks` keys must be existing `checklist_items.id` values.
- `edges[].order` is unique inside the array and lies in 1–400; density (`{1..N}` with no gap) is maintained by the client engine, never enforced by the server.
- The table is named `training_sessions` because `sessions` belongs to Laravel's database session driver; both coexist (migration docblock).

#### `users`

`database/migrations/0001_01_01_000000_create_users_table.php` + `2025_08_14_170933_add_two_factor_columns_to_users_table.php`, `app/Models/User.php`.

- Fillable: `name`, `email`, `password`. Hidden: `password`, `two_factor_secret`, `two_factor_recovery_codes`, `remember_token`.
- Casts: `email_verified_at` datetime, `password` `hashed`, `two_factor_confirmed_at` datetime.
- Implements `Laravel\Fortify\Contracts\PasskeyUser`; uses `PasskeyAuthenticatable`, `TwoFactorAuthenticatable`, `Notifiable`.
- `hasMany(TrainingSession::class)`; deletion cascades at the database level.
- Related tables: `passkeys` (`2024_01_01_000000_create_passkeys_table.php`). `password_reset_tokens` exists from the framework migration but no route exposes the flow.

#### Catalog entities (read-only at runtime)

All 11 use `App\Concerns\ReadOnlyAtRuntime` (throws outside console) and `App\Concerns\HasActiveScope`; ordering comes from `#[ScopedBy(OrderByPosition::class)]` (or `OrderByCategoryPosition` for `components`).

| Table | Columns (beyond `id` + timestamps) | Relationships | Unique / index | Seeded rows |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `problem_levels` | `name(40)`, `slug(40)`, `position`, `is_active` | `hasMany` `problems` | `slug` unique | 3 — `base`, `intermediate`, `advanced` |
| `problem_item_types` | `name(60)`, `slug(40)`, `description(255)` nullable, `is_active` | `hasMany` `problem_items` | `slug` unique | 3 — `requirement`, `scale`, `topic` |
| `component_categories` | `name(60)`, `slug(40)`, `color_token(40)`, `position`, `is_active` | `hasMany` `components` | `slug`, `color_token` unique | 6 — `client`, `edge`, `compute`, `data`, `async`, `ops` |
| `link_types` | `name(60)`, `slug(20)`, `badge_label(12)`, `dash_array(20)` nullable, `is_bidirectional_default`, `gloss(255)`, `position`, `is_active` | referenced by `edges[].kind` (JSON, by slug) | `slug` unique | 9 — `http`, `grpc`, `ws`, `event`, `query`, `cache`, `repl`, `batch`, `retry` |
| `session_durations` | `minutes` smallint, `is_default`, `position`, `is_active` | `hasMany` `training_sessions` | `minutes` unique | 3 — 30, **45 (default)**, 60 |
| `estimate_modes` | `name(60)`, `slug(20)`, `highlighted_row(60)`, `position`, `is_active` | referenced by `estimate.mode` (JSON, by slug) | `slug` unique | 2 — `user`, `month` |
| `problems` | `slug(40)`, `name(120)`, `tag(80)`, `problem_level_id` FK restrict, `context` text, `position`, `is_active` | `belongsTo` `ProblemLevel`; `hasMany` `problemItems`, plus the filtered `requirements()`, `scaleTargets()`, `topics()`; `hasMany` `trainingSessions`; referenced by `training_sessions.problem_id` | `slug` unique; index `(problem_level_id, position)` | 14 |
| `problem_items` | `problem_id` FK cascade, `problem_item_type_id` FK restrict, `position`, `content` text | `belongsTo` `Problem`, `ProblemItemType` | unique `(problem_id, problem_item_type_id, position)` | 3 lists × 14 problems |
| `components` | `component_category_id` FK restrict, `slug(40)`, `name(80)`, `short_name(60)`, `icon_key(40)`, `position`, `is_active` | `belongsTo` `ComponentCategory`; referenced by `nodes[].type` (JSON, by slug) | `slug` unique; index `(component_category_id, position)` | 28 |
| `phases` | `slug(40)`, `name(120)`, `weight` decimal(4,3), `position`, `is_active` | `hasMany` `ChecklistItem` | `slug` unique, `position` unique | 5, weights 0.110 / 0.110 / 0.180 / 0.270 / 0.330 |
| `checklist_items` | `phase_id` FK cascade, `position`, `content(255)`, `is_active` | `belongsTo` `Phase`; ids are the keys of `training_sessions.checks` | unique `(phase_id, position)` | 25 |

Cross-cutting invariants:
- `component_categories.color_token` is the single source of color — no other catalog table has a color column, and `ComponentResource` omits color deliberately.
- `phases.weight` values sum to exactly 1.000, which makes roteiro progress close at 100% (`PhaseSeeder` docblock).
- `components.icon_key` must resolve in `resources/js/canvas/icons.ts`; `ComponentSeeder` sets it equal to `slug`.
- `link_types.dash_array` `null` means a solid stroke.
- No `enum` column exists in any migration and no model casts a domain attribute to a PHP Enum — every domain concept is a lookup row.
- `is_active = false` hides a row from the UI but `CatalogService` still ships it when the loaded session references it, so old drawings keep rendering.

| `jobs`, `job_batches`, `failed_jobs` | `0001_01_01_000002_create_jobs_table.php` | `QUEUE_CONNECTION=database` default; nothing dispatches — no job class, no `ShouldQueue`, no scheduler entry |
| `sessions` | `0001_01_01_000000_create_users_table.php` | Laravel session driver (`SESSION_DRIVER=database`); distinct from `training_sessions` |

### Cache

No server-side cache is read or written by application code. All caching in this system is browser-local and holds either a draft or a preference:

| Key | Owner | Contents | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sd-session-{id}` | `resources/js/prancheta/resume.ts` (`SESSION_CACHE_PREFIX`, `SESSION_CACHE_VERSION = 1`) | `{version, id, savedAt, serverUpdatedAt, body}` | Local mirror written 800 ms after each change and on `beforeunload`/`pagehide`; on boot `serverMovedOn()` compares `serverUpdatedAt` against the server payload to decide who is newer. Unreadable entries are treated as absent so a corrupted item cannot block the board. |
| `sd-theme` | `resources/js/prancheta/theme.ts` (`THEME_STORAGE_KEY`) | board theme | Browser preference, never sent to the server; separate from the starter kit's `useAppearance` cookie. |
| `sd-legend` | `resources/js/prancheta/legend.ts` (`LEGEND_STORAGE_KEY`) | legend collapsed state | Browser preference, never sent to the server. |

In-memory server state: none beyond the request. The training clock has no server-side "running" flag — only `elapsed_seconds` is persisted, and the board always boots paused.
